category: Trade defence measures including anti-dumping, countervailing duties and safeguards on ICT-related goods imported by other economies within the considered United Nations region
criteria:
1) More than three measures
2) Three measures
3) Two measures
4) One measure
5) No measure
(0.25 for each measure, up to 1)

category: Foreign exclusions from public procurement related to ICT goods and digital services
criteria:
1) For any legislative measure excludes foreign firms from public procurement under any circumstances, or more than one measure under category (2)
2) For any legislative measure excludes a specific (group) of foreign firm(s) from public procurement
3) No measure (when there is only a legal basis that grants the government the power to exclude foreign firms)

category: Specific requirements on source codes, encryption and trade secrets
criteria:
1) For any requirement to surrender patents, source codes or trade secrets as a condition for participating in tenders
2) For any requirement to use specific encryption to win tenders
3) No measure

category: Limitations in procurement bidding
criteria:
1) For any measure that directly discriminate against foreign bidders OR more than one measure under category (2)
2) For any measures measure that applies to all bidders, such as local content requirements and performance-based conditions
3) No measure (when there is only a legal basis that grants the government the power to impose limitations in procurement bidding)

category:
Foreign equity limits in sectors relevant to digital trade 
Exception: Not cover foreign equity cap in telecom sector (covered under Pillar 5) and e-commerce sector (covered under Pillar 12)
criteria:
1) Ban (0%) in at least one sector OR if only a minority stake in more than one sector
2) A minority stake (1-50%) allowed in one sector
3) A controlling stake (51-99%) allowed OR restrictions only exist in SOEs
4) Full ownership (100%) allowed in relevant for digital trade

category: Joint venture requirements
criteria:
1) For any measure 
2) No measure

category: Nationality or residency requirements for board of directors or managers
criteria:
1) For any measure 
2) No measure

category:
Screening of investment and acquisitions
Exception: Anti-trust measures related to M&A are not considered a restriction, unless discriminatory.
criteria:
1) A case that the screening mechanism has been used to block an investment in a sector relevant for digital trade
2) Two or more investment screening mechanisms 
3) A screening mechanism
4) No screening mechanism

category: Commercial presence requirements to offer cross-border services in sectors relevant to digital trade
criteria:
1) For any measure
2) No measure

category: Patent application issues
criteria:
1) Differential treatment between local and foreign firms, requirements to appoint local representative, and a rejection of patent application in a discriminatory manner. 
2) Non-transparent process, high filing fees, high registration costs, substantive examination, and the requirement to file a patent locally before filing abroad. 
3) No restriction

category: Patent enforcement issues: civil and administrative procedures and remedies; and provisional measures
criteria:
1) Abesence of civil and administrative procedures and remedies, and provisional measures
2) Adopt civil and administrative procedures and remedies, or provisional measures
3) Adopt civil and administrative procedures and remedies, and provisional measures

category: Patent enforcement issues: others
criteria:
1) For any restriction with high impact, when the issue affecting all circumstances and sectors, OR more than one measure of category (2)
2) For any restriction with limited impact, when the issue affecting to a specific circumstance or sector
3) No restriction

category: Lack of copyright framework and exceptions
criteria:
1) Lack of copyright legal framework OR lack of copyright exceptions
2) Unclear copyright exceptions, such as three-step test and other types of copyright exceptions
3) Clear copyright exceptions following fair use or fair dealing model

category: Online copyright enforcement issues: civil and administrative procedures and remedies; and provisional measures
criteria:
1) Abesence of civil and administrative procedures and remedies, and provisional measures
2) Adopt civil and administrative procedures and remedies, or provisional measures
3) Adopt civil and administrative procedures and remedies, and provisional measures

category: Mandatory disclosure of trade secrets, such as souce code and algorithms
criteria:
1) For any disclosure requirement affecting an entire sector or all sectors horizontally OR More than one measure of category (2)
2) For any disclosure requirement of limited impact affecting only specific types of products or specific circumstance (i.e., disclosure due to court order, regulatory proceedings, or national threat provision for certain companies)
3) No measure OR when the Government mandates to disclose trade secrets when necessary to protect the public interest and safeguards against unfair commercial use

category: Lack of effective trade secrets legal framework
criteria:
1) Lack of trade secrets legal framework that is able to provide effective protection
2) Limited practice/scope addressing protection of trade secrets OR practices with certain clauses included in the IP law/ relevant law
3) Presence of effective protection of trade secrets protection in any forms

category: Lack of passive infrastructure sharing
criteria:
1) No passive infrastructure sharing obligation
2) Passive sharing is not mandated, but it is practiced in the market
3) Passive sharing is mandated

category: Foreign equity limits in telecom sector
criteria:
1) Ban (0%) OR if only a minority stake in more than one measures
2) A minority stake (1-50%) allowed 
3) A controlling stake (51-99%) allowed OR restrictions only exist in SOEs
4) Full ownership (100%) allowed in telecommunication sector

category: Shares owned by the Government in telecom companies
criteria:
1) At least one companies with government shares above 50% OR more than one measure of category (2)
2) One company with government shares between 1% and 50% 
3) No shares owned by the government in telecom companies

category: Lack of functional/accounting separation
criteria:
1) No funcation/accounting separation is mandated 
2) Only accounting separation is mandated
3) Only functional seperation is mandated
4) Both accounting and functional separations are mandated

category: Licensing requirements in telecom sector for operators
criteria:
1) For any strict licensing scheme (e.g., discrimination for foreign providers, minimum capital requirements, and mandatory performances requirements)
2) No strict licensing scheme

category: Lack of independent telecom authority
criteria:
1) No independent telecom authority
2) Independent telecom authority is established

category:
Ban and local processing requirements
Exception: Not score data localization measure applied to government data.
criteria:
1) Ban and/or local processing requirement for all sectors or personal data, OR more than one measure in category (2)
2) Ban and/or local processing  requirement applied to specific sector, specific data, non-personal data, or transfer is prohibited to one country
3) No requirement

category:
Local storage requirements
Exception: Not score data localization measure applied to government data.
criteria:
1) Local storage requirement for all sectors or personal data, OR more than one measure in category (2)
2) Local storage requirement applied to specific sector, specific data or non-personal data
3) No requirement

category:
Infrastructure requirements
Exception: Not score data localization measure applied to government data.
criteria:
1) Infrastructure requirement
2) No requirement

category:
Conditional flow regimes
Exception: Not score data localization measure applied to government data.
criteria:
1) Conditions for all sectors or personal data 
2) Conditions for specific data or non-personal data
3) No condition

category: Lack of comprehensive legal framework for data protection
criteria:
1) No data protection legal framework
2) Data protection legal framework only to specific sectors (sectoral law)
3) Comprehensive data protection framework

category: Lack of dedicated legal framework for cybersecurity
criteria:
1) No cybersecurity legal framework
2) Non-dedicated cybersecurity legal framework and/or dedicated cybersecurity law only to specific sectors (sectoral law)
3) Dedicated cybersecurity legal framework (horizontal)

category:
Minimum period of data retention requirements
Exception: Not score requirement applied to government data.
criteria:
1) Minimum period of data retention requirement
2) No data retention requirement

category: Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) or Data Protection Officer (DPO) requirements
criteria:
1) DPO and DPIA OR only DPO requirement, applied to all sectors
2) DPO and DPIA OR only DPO requirement, applied to a specific sector
3) No requirement

category: Requirements to allow government access to personal data
criteria:
1) For any measure that allows government to access data without court orders
2) No measure

category: Lack of safe harbour for copyright infringements
criteria:
1) No intermediary liability framework in place
2) Sectoral framework in place that limits liablity for intermediaries
3) Hoirzontal framework in place that limits liability for intermediaries

category: Lack of safe harbour for other illegal activities
criteria:
1) No intermediary liability framework in place
2) Sectoral framework in place that limits liablity for intermediaries
3) Hoirzontal framework in place that limits liability for intermediaries

category: User identify requirements
criteria:
1) User identity requirement to connect to the Internet or access online services 
2) Used identity requirement for SIM registration
3) No restrictions

category: Monitoring requirements
criteria:
1) Any monitoring requirement (monitor the users’ activities or remove or block content)
2) Any requirement to active monitoring of users’ activities without any legal obligation to remove or block the content
3) No measure

category:
Blocking or filtering commercial web content
Exception: Not score political content, criminal content (e.g., child pornography), aged-restricted content, defamation and other non-commercial content.
criteria:
1) Any blocking measure 
2) Any filtering measure
3) No cases of blocking nor filtering (except internationally agreed illegal content/child pornography)

category:
Online advertising requirements
Exception: Not score requirements that advertising should not be misleading
criteria:
1) Any restriction on online advertising
2) No restriction

category:
Licensing requirements for online content providers and applications (social media platforms, new providers, VPN, cloud servics, etc.)
Exception: Not cover license for telecommunication facilities and service providers (captured under Pillar 5), License for e-commerce platform (captured under Pillar 12)
criteria:
1) Any strict licence requirement/ cases of more than one measure in category (2)
2) Any licensing scheme
3) No restriction

category: Import ban applied to ICT goods and online services (e.g. network equipment, servers, handsets, applications, and data processing)
criteria:
1) Ban on more than one ICT goods or digital services
2) Ban on one specific product or services
3) No measure

category: Other import restrictions on ICT goods and online services
criteria:
1) Import restrictions that potentially block trade (e.g., quotas) OR at least two measures of category (2)
2) Import estrictions that add regulatory compliance costs to trade in ICT goods and online services (e.g., licenses, permits, authorization, registration for ICT goods and labelling requirements and import controls)
3) No restriction

category: Local content requirements
criteria:
1) At least one LCR at sectoral or horizontal level (i.e. HS-4 (e.g.telephony equipment)) and HS-2 levels) OR at least two LCRs of category (2)
2) At least one LCR at product level (i.e. HS-6 and HS-8 levels (e.g. mobile phones and smartphones)
3) No measure

category: Export restrictions on ICTgoods and online services
criteria:
1) Export restriction
2) No restriction

category: Lack of transparent technical standards
criteria:
1) Not allowed foreigners to participate in the standard-setting bodies, OR non transparent standard-setting
2) No restriction

category: Self-certification limitations for product safety (radio transmissions, EMC/EMI)
criteria:
1) Not allow SDoC and third-party certification 
2) SDoC is not allowed, but accept 3rd party-certification from CABs from a number of countries with MRA 
3) SDoC is allowed for foreign business

category: Product screening and testing requirements
criteria:
1) Measure in place and used for products in scope
2) Measure in place, but acceptance of 3rd party testing results
3) No requirement

category: Deviation from international encryption standards (ISO, IEC, ITU, FIPS, AES, TDES, and ECC)
criteria:
1) For any measure or known case
2) No restriction

category: Foreign equity limits in e-commerce sector
criteria:
1) A minority stakes  (1-50%) allowed 
2) A controlling stake (51-99%) allowed
3) Full ownership (100%) allowed in e-commerce sector

category:
Online purchases and delivery limitations
Exception: Not score limitations on online purchases and delivery applied specifically to products related to consumer protection, notably restrictions on alcoholic beverages, tobacco, and pharmaceuticals.
criteria:
1) Any measure limits the number of products that can be purchases online AND restrictions to delivery of products bought online
2) No measure

category:
Licensing scheme for e-commerce providers (B2B and B2C)
Exception: Licenses pertiaining to other aspects of e-commerce businesses, such as license to operate online payment services and delivery are not captured.
criteria:
1) Any license for e-commerce providers
2) No license

category: Online payment limitations: mandate local bank account
criteria:
1) Requirements to use a local bank account
2) No restriction

category: Online payment limitations: mandate currency used for international payments
criteria:
1) Requirements on the currency used for international payments
2) No restriction

category: Online payment limitations: deviate national standards
criteria:
1) National standards for payment security that deviate from international standards
2) No restriction

category: Online payment limitations: licensing requirements
criteria:
1) Licensing requirements with restrictive conditions
2) No restriction

category: Online payment limitations: ceiling on the maximum amount
criteria:
1) Ceilings on the maximum amount that can be paid by electronic payment methods
2) No restriction

category: Online payment limitations: mandate specific intermediaries
criteria:
1) Requirements mandating the use of specific intermediaries for online payments
2) No restriction

category: Online payment limitations: others restrictions
criteria:
1) Other restrctions
2) No restriction

category: Low De Minimis
criteria:
1) No De Minimis
2) De Minimis below < 200 USD
3) De Minimis ≥ 200 USD

category: Imposition of custom duties on electronic transmission
criteria:
1) Imposition of custom duties on electronic transmission
2) Legal mechanisms or regulations applicable to impose custom duties on electronic transmission
3) No restriction

category: Domain name requirements
criteria:
1) Physical presence required, requirements to the registrater a local domain name to conduct electronic retail 
2) Local representative required
3) No restriction

category: Local presence requirements for online service providers
criteria:
1) Local presence requirement for at least one sector
2) No requirement

category: Lack of legal framework for online consumer protection
criteria:
1) No consumer protection legal framework applicable to online commerce 
2) Consumer protection law applicable to online commerce
